fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco's share of tax-paying cigarette sales rose from about 55% in 2012 to about 70% by June 2025, according to the cited survey and latest report.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Philip Morris Pakistan's share of tax-paying cigarette sales fell from about 33% in 2012 to about 13% by June 2025 as rivals gained.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Khyber Tobacco competes at the low-price end of the tax-paying market with brands such as Kissan and Gold Street, which the analyst says is what drives its share gains.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco is described as the largest listed cigarette company, earning higher profit on fewer cigarettes sold because its margin per pack is strong.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tax-paid cigarette sales in Pakistan were about 67 billion sticks in 2013, according to the analyst's figures.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When taxes rise faster than legal prices, price-sensitive smokers move to cheaper smuggled or non-tax-paid brands, which erodes the volume of tax-paying makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Brands sold below the total tax due on a pack can only be priced that way by evading duty, so widespread low prices are evidence of tax avoidance.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If the government brings illicit cigarette trade into the tax net, the analyst expects cigarette tax revenue to roughly double and legal makers' sales and profits to rise sharply.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Raw materials, namely tobacco leaf, filter paper and packaging, make up about 40-45% of a cigarette maker's total cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Factory costs plus advertising and distribution together make up only about 10-15% of a cigarette maker's total cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tobacco leaf is grown domestically, mainly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and parts of Punjab, and farmers sell their crop to manufacturers every year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A cigarette's tax has two layers, federal excise duty and sales tax (GST), and together they make up a large share of the pack price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cigarette brands are sorted into three tax tiers by price: premium (Gold Leaf, Marlboro, Benson and Hedges, Dunhill), mid-priced (Capstan, Morven, Gold Flag) and low-priced (Kissan, Parliament, Olympic).
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The net profit left on a legal cigarette after tax and costs is a thin per-stick amount, so tax evasion gives illicit sellers a large pricing cushion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's 2025 estimate puts Pakistan Tobacco's revenue at about PKR 350 billion, net of taxes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's 2025 estimate puts Pakistan Tobacco's net profit after income tax at about PKR 32 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues Pakistan Tobacco compounds value because its business model is strong enough to keep profit growing even as cigarette volumes fall.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco has added a modern nicotine-pouch brand, Willow, alongside traditional cigarettes, and the analyst sees modern products as its next growth segment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco runs a Made in Pakistan export initiative that ships its products to Japan, Gulf countries and Europe, with France and Peru on its future target list.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: As regulators tighten rules on vapes and heated products, nicotine demand shifts toward pouches rather than disappearing, so makers with pouch products can keep participating.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst describes cigarette brand loyalty as a legacy built by branding, which protects established brands against cheaper entrants.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's tobacco export value rose from about 64 million to 166 million across FY2024 and FY2025, which the analyst describes as growth of more than 150%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cigarette taxes add substantial government revenue, while the same product drives heavy health costs, so tobacco policy trades revenue against health outcomes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know before Investing in Cigarette Industry of Pakistan' (YouTube transcript, undated)
